zh.title: 華航與長榮航空8月營收雙創單月歷年次高
zh.summary: 華航與長榮航8月營收雙創歷年次高；長榮航客運創新高並規劃增飛航線
body: 受惠於8月暑期旅遊旺季、票價反映油價成本升幅，以及AI伺服器與半導體高科技產品出貨強勁，華航與長榮航空2026年8月合併營收雙雙寫下歷史單月次高紀錄。華航8月合併營收達新台幣219.48億元，較去年同期成長27.22%；長榮航空8月合併營收則達228.91億元，年增率為24.92%。
在華航方面，8月客運收入達到124.45億元，年增19.24%，創下歷年同期新高，其中以東北亞航線載客率表現最佳。貨運收入則為75.2億元，較去年同期成長36.06%。華航表示，雖然8月受颱風及歐洲暑期、日本盂蘭盆節長假影響，使部分航班調整與需求略為放緩，但AI伺服器及半導體設備等出貨動能暢旺帶動包機需求，後續將持續爭取高價包艙與臨時加包機貨源。
長榮航空8月客運營收達到142.08億元，創下歷史新高，年增21.06%；貨運營收為58.45億元，年增28.72%。長榮航空指出，台灣出發的歐美長程航線平均載客率突破9成，東北亞與東南亞等區域航線載客維持高檔。累計今年前8月，長榮航空客運營收達1093.69億元，累計合併營收達1736.30億元，雙雙刷新歷年同期最高紀錄。
航線規劃方面，長榮航空宣布自9月21日至10月11日期間，新增桃園至仁川航線加班機，規劃以空中巴士A333與波音777機型執飛，每週航班數將由14班增加至18班。此外，長榮航空自2026年10月25日起，亦將增飛桃園至杭州航線航班，採用空中巴士A321機型營運，每週航班數將由3班增加至5班。

en.title: China Airlines and EVA Air Post Second-Highest Monthly Revenues for August
en.summary: China Airlines and EVA Air report second-highest August revenues amid strong summer travel and cargo demand.
body: China Airlines and EVA Airways both recorded their second-highest monthly consolidated revenues on record in August 2026, driven by peak summer travel demand, fare adjustments reflecting fuel costs, and strong momentum in shipments of AI servers and semiconductor equipment. China Airlines reported August consolidated revenue of NT$21.948 billion, representing a 27.22 percent increase compared to the same period last year. Meanwhile, EVA Airways generated consolidated revenue of NT$22.891 billion for the month, representing a year-on-year increase of 24.92 percent.

For China Airlines, August passenger revenue reached NT$12.445 billion, up 19.24 percent year-on-year and setting a record high for the corresponding period, with Northeast Asian routes delivering the strongest load factors. The carrier's cargo revenue reached NT$7.52 billion, marking a 36.06 percent year-on-year growth. Despite minor demand slowdowns and flight adjustments caused by typhoons and summer holidays in Europe and Japan, China Airlines noted robust demand for high-tech cargo charters and plans to capture high-value block space and charter opportunities as peak season approaches.

EVA Airways achieved a record-high monthly passenger revenue of NT$14.208 billion in August, up 21.06 percent year-on-year, while its cargo revenue reached NT$5.845 billion, a 28.72 percent year-on-year gain. The airline reported average load factors exceeding 90 percent on long-haul routes from Taiwan to Europe and North America, while demand across Northeast and Southeast Asian routes remained elevated. For the first eight months of the year, EVA Airways accumulated NT$109.369 billion in passenger revenue and NT$173.630 billion in consolidated revenue, both reaching all-time highs for the period.

To meet growing passenger demand, EVA Airways announced schedule expansions on regional routes from Taoyuan. Between September 21 and October 11, the airline will add extra flights on the Taoyuan to Incheon route using Airbus A333 and Boeing 777 aircraft, raising weekly frequency from 14 to 18 flights. Additionally, starting October 25, 2026, EVA Airways will increase its Taoyuan to Hangzhou service from 3 to 5 weekly flights using Airbus A321 aircraft.

zh.title: 星宇航空與台灣虎航8月營收創高 拓展航網與維修業務
zh.summary: 星宇與台灣虎航8月營收創新高；星宇獲EASA認證並佈局新航線
body: 星宇航空發布2026年8月業績，單月營收達新台幣55.79億元，較去年同期成長48%；今年前8月累計營收達398.6億元，年增率為34%。在各項業務表現方面，8月客運營收為43.12億元，年增45%；8月貨運營收則為6.72億元，年增41%，主要受惠於亞洲輸往北美地區的人工智慧及半導體相關產品持續保持出貨動能。
台灣虎航公布2026年8月單月營收為新台幣17.88億元，年增22%，創下歷年同期新高紀錄。受惠於暑假旺季旅遊需求強勁，台灣虎航8月平均載客率接近94%，寫下歷史新高。今年前8月累計班次較去年同期增加10.8%，平均載客率約91%，累計前8月營業收入達138.83億元，年成長23%。
在航網布局與營運規劃方面，星宇航空首條歐洲航線台北至布拉格已於8月1日啟航，並自9月起升級為空中巴士A350-1000執飛，10月1日起與捷克最大航空公司Smartwings展開聯航合作並提供行李直掛服務。此外，星宇航空預計10月起開闢台中至札幌與台中至名古屋航線，並於2027年1月1日起開航高雄至神戶及高雄至沖繩航線，屆時中南部每週航班將達82班。
為因應冬季旅遊需求，星宇航空規劃於冬季班表對台北至函館、台北至清邁、台北至吉隆坡及台北至河內航線進行增班，並放大機型以空中巴士A330neo廣體客機執飛。在北美航網部分，台北至安大略及台北至鳳凰城航線將於旺季區間增班至每週5班。台灣虎航則於9月初首航高雄至小松及高雄至石垣島航線，使高雄出發航線拓展至14條。
除航網拓展外，星宇航空宣布耗時18個月取得歐洲航空安全局（EASA）維修廠認證，代表其維修品質、技術及系統通過國際檢核，未來將可開始承接各國籍民用航空器的維修業務，進一步擴大營運業務範圍。

en.title: Starlux Airlines and Tigerair Taiwan Report Strong Revenue Growth in August
en.summary: Starlux Airlines and Tigerair Taiwan reported strong August revenues while expanding network operations and maintenance capabilities.
body: Starlux Airlines reported its financial performance for August 2026, generating revenue of NT$5.579 billion, which represents a 48% increase compared to the same period last year. Accumulated revenue for the first eight months reached NT$39.86 billion, up 34% year-on-year. Passenger revenue in August reached NT$4.312 billion, marking a 45% increase, while cargo revenue rose 41% to NT$672 million, driven by sustained shipment demand for artificial intelligence and semiconductor products from Asia to North America.

Tigerair Taiwan recorded August revenue of NT$1.788 billion, up 22% year-on-year and setting a new historic high for the month. Benefiting from strong travel demand during the summer peak season, the carrier achieved an average load factor of nearly 94%, the highest in its operational history. For the first eight months of 2026, flights increased by 10.8% compared to the prior year with an average load factor of 91%, generating total revenue of NT$13.883 billion.

Regarding route network expansion, Starlux Airlines deployed Airbus A350-1000 aircraft on its Taipei to Prague route starting in September following its August launch. The carrier established an interline agreement with Smartwings taking effect on October 1, enabling through-checked baggage services for passengers. Starlux Airlines will launch flights from Taichung to Sapporo and Nagoya in October, followed by new routes connecting Kaohsiung to Kobe and Okinawa starting January 1, 2027, bringing weekly operations from central and southern Taiwan to 82 flights.

For the upcoming winter schedule, Starlux Airlines plans to increase frequencies and deploy widebody Airbus A330neo aircraft on routes from Taipei to Hakodate, Chiang Mai, Kuala Lumpur, and Hanoi. High-demand North American services from Taipei to Ontario and Phoenix will increase to five weekly flights during peak periods. Meanwhile, Tigerair Taiwan inaugurated flights from Kaohsiung to Komatsu and Ishigaki in early September, expanding its network from Kaohsiung to 14 routes.

In technical capabilities, Starlux Airlines announced that it obtained maintenance organization certification from the European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) after an 18-month evaluation process. The certification confirms that the airline's maintenance quality, technology, and systems comply with international standards, allowing Starlux Airlines to provide commercial aircraft maintenance services to global customers.
